data.title: Add Login and Accounts
data.outcome: Understand the full login path from page to server, then verify account state and permissions.
intentExamples: Show different content to different users

stages.title: Design a clear login entry point and form
stages.action: Build the login page, field labels, and error placement.
stages.evidence: Direct visits, refreshes, and keyboard use all work correctly.

lessons.title: Centered Column
lessons.tagline: Keep one narrow content column centered on the page

lessons.title: Form
lessons.tagline: Collect several fields and submit them as one task

lessons.title: Label
lessons.tagline: Visible text that tells people what a form control asks for

stages.title: Send credentials safely to the server
stages.action: Connect the login request and handle success and error responses.
stages.evidence: Passwords never appear in the URL, and errors do not reveal sensitive account information.

lessons.title: HTTP
lessons.tagline: Send a request and receive a response over the web

lessons.title: Route & Endpoint
lessons.tagline: Match a request path and method to the code that handles it

lessons.title: Validation
lessons.tagline: Check that incoming data has the expected shape and allowed values

stages.title: Have the server verify the user's identity
stages.action: Use a mature identity solution or a secure server-side verification flow.
stages.evidence: The login state behaves as expected after a refresh, and secrets never reach the front end.

lessons.title: Authentication
lessons.tagline: Verify who is making the request

lessons.title: Env Var
lessons.tagline: Provide configuration outside the source code

stages.title: Save and load account data again
stages.action: Save the needed user data and implement reading it back.
stages.evidence: After signing out and back in, the correct account data is still available.

lessons.title: Database
lessons.tagline: Store and find application data such as users, posts, and orders

lessons.title: JSON
lessons.tagline: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange

stages.title: Control what users can access and change
stages.action: Check permissions on the server for key pages and actions.
stages.evidence: Unauthorized requests are rejected even if someone bypasses the front end.

lessons.title: Authorization
lessons.tagline: Decide what an authenticated user is allowed to see or change

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page
